dns.about_before: Ibhokisi elihlukile, ithokheni elivalwe: i-broker iyisizathu sayo esivalwe, ithokheni lokubhala aliphumi kuyo, futhi ukunikeza imvume kuhamba ngegunya ledomeyni. Ukunikeza nokucela izitifiketi kuhamba nge-mesh —
dns.budget_body: Izilinganiso zasontikezo zokukhipha ngedomeyni nangegama nezinkomo zokwenqaba kusengaphambili, ukuze i-host eyodwa engasebenzi ngendlela efanele ingalisele ibhajethi ye-Let's Encrypt yedomeyni. I-ledger engenhla iseyirekhoda lokho i-rail engakubala.
dns.ddns_body: I-node ehambayo iqondisa kabusha i-A-record yayo ngokuvuselelwa okusayiniwe — isitifiketi esifanayo, akukho ukukhipha okusha, akukho bhajethi esetshenzisiwe. Ikluliwe, kodwa ayikayakhelwa.
dns.drop_cred_body: Ithokheni lishaywe amakhodi lapho ligcinwe futhi alifundwa futhi kusikrini. Ukulibeka kwenza leli bhokisi likwazi uku-broker idomeyni.
dns.how_1: Igama likhethwa — imvume ibiza i-host eyodwa kuphela ngaphansi kodomeyni okubrokered.
dns.how_4: I-node isebenzisa isitifiketi sangempela — ukuvuselelwa kuphinda indlela efanayo.
dns.intro: Amagama angempela nezitifiketi zangempela zamajhuba emesh: igunya linikeza, i-broker ibhala irekhodi futhi ifakazele igama, bese ijhuba lisebenzisa isitifiketi sangempela. Ithokeni ebhalela i-DNS liqiniswe ebhokisini le-broker — ibhalelwa kuphela, ibhishwe, futhi ayisakhonywa muntu futhi.
dns.ledger_cite: Ukungeza kuphela — zonke izitifiketi le-broker eyake yazikhipha.
dns.ledger_title: Irekhodi lokukhipha (leli bhokisi okuyikho okusebenzisa i-broker)
dns.no_authz: Azikho izimvume ze-broker eziphilayo ezaziwa yileli bhokisi.
dns.no_creds_after: Ibhokisi lidinga eyodwa kuphela lapho lisebenzisa i-broker yedomeini — amajhuba amaningi aweke ayenzi lokhu.
dns.pername_body: Unikezo olulodwa, igama elilodwa lomshini — indlela eyodwa engenazo izivimbelo, izamwa kuqala, ishibhile.
dns.routing_body: Ubufakazi obusayiniwe — ukuthi iyiphi i-broker engasebenza ngaphansi kwedomeini iyiphi, ngokwegunya ledomeini. Kusabalaliswa emesh; i-mint ayikwazi ukulibaleka lokhu.
dns.signin_body: Izimfihlo, izimvume, nerekhodi lokukhipha zikhonywa kuphela kumsebenzi osayiniwe waleli bhokisi.
dns.wildcard_body: Uhlobo oluhlukile lonikezo oluthinta ucingo lokwethemba oluvikelekile: olukhiphwe yi-authority, ukuvunyelwa kwedomeini ngalinye, okungaba nomgomo wokuvuma ophakeme. Klanywe, kodwa akakabi akhiwe.

identity.check_action_detail: Ithuluzi sisaingisile lolu bhalo ngqo (ifomu + payload + subject) — ukungaphiki.
identity.check_attestation_detail: Ikhiyi eliqinisiwe lokukhisa kuqinisekisa isithombe — kuhleleka ngokuphela kwesikhathi, ukukhutshelwa, noma ukushintshwa.
identity.check_subject_detail: Umsebenzisi oqinisekisiwe uxazululwa ngokuhambisana nendawo ngaphambi kokuba i-engine ivumele.
identity.devices_caption: Izikhi zezinto zokusebenza zomsebenzi ezibhaliswe kule bhokisi
identity.devices_intro: Isinto ngasinye sokusebenza sibhalisa ikhi yaso. Ukuba nekhi yesinto sokusebenza — hhayi iphasiwedi — yilokho okunye izivutha okukubona.
identity.enrol_body: Isinto sokusebenza sibhalisa ikhi yaso yomphakathi ye-Ed25519 — imfihlo ayiphumi ngisho nakanjani esintweni (akukho escrow).
identity.enrol_lr_after: ikhi ishicilelwe; ingxenye eyimfihlo ayiphumi ngisho nakanjani esintweni. Akukho lapho ikhi eyimfihlo ingaba khona.
identity.enrol_note: Ukubhalisa kushicilela ikhi yomphakathi yesinto; ukuxhumanisa kufakazela ukuba nekhi esebhaliswe kakade ebhokisi entsha. Imfihlo ayiphumi ngisho nakanjani esintweni.
identity.forwarded_intro: Lapho ukubhala okuphathiswe kufika, kumele kudlule kuzihlolo zozithathu ngaphambi kokuba injini ikuvumele. Kunoma iyiphi ukwehluleka, kuvinjwa.
identity.intro: Isigaba sokuzazi esivumela isivutha ukuba yazi ukuthi ungubani ku-mesh, futhi sivumela isimo somphakathi somvoti ukuba sihambe naye esivutheni esingeyikhashi. Kukhona ukuzazi okuhlukile kubili lapha — okwakho njengomsebenzi, nesimo esifakazelwe somvoti odlulayo. Azihlangani neze.
identity.keystone_body: Ukubhala okuphathiswe kuyikhiye: umuntu odlula esivutheni esingeyikhashi usengakwazi ukusebenza, ngoba isimo sakhe sihamba njengokufakazela okusayiniwe okwesikhathi esifushane futhi isinto sakhe sayisayina isenzo uqobo lwaso.
identity.keystone_cite: isimo sihamba; ilungelo ngokwalo lihleleka, aligcinwa neze
identity.lr_password: Iphasiwedi yakho yasendaweni ikungenisa kule bhokisi kuphela — ezinye izibhokisi zikubona ngokuba nekhi yesinto, hhayi ngephasiwedi.
identity.no_devices_body: I-akhawunti yomsebenzi ingena ngephasiwedi yayo yasendaweni kuphela. Ukubhalisa isinto kushicilela ikhi yomphakathi ye-Ed25519, ukuze ezinye izibhokisi zikubone ngokuba nekhi.
identity.no_mesh_id_body: Le bhokisi ayikayenza isethu sakwayo sekhi ye-Ed25519. Isenza okokuqala lapho umfelandawonye uyidinga — ukufunda le khasi akukhiyi.
identity.secret_note: Ingxenye eyimfihlo yekeyi yokusayina ayiphumi kuleli bhokisi futhi ayikho kuleli khasi. Abahlangani banamathisela ikeyi yomphakathi; i-node isayina ngokwayo.
identity.signin_body: I-identity plane ibonakala kuphela kumsebenzi osayinele. Akukho lutho lapha olunamandla omthethosisekelo — yindlela leli bhokisi elifakazela ukuthi yiliphi ibhokisi elikhulumayo.
identity.subject_note: Isihloko: umsebenzi oqinisekiswe uxazululwa ngokuhambisana nendawo ngaphambi kwegunya — ubulungiswa bufundwa buqondile, abukholelwa nje ngocingo.
identity.sweep_body: Umsebenzi wokuhlanza ususa ukuqinisekisa okuphelile (sekuvele kuyahluleka lapho kuphela; ukuhlanza nje kunciphisa itafula, kususa kancane ukuze kwenziwe ucwaningo).
identity.travel_intro_after: . Lokhu kuqinisekisa yilokho okuvumela umdlali ovakashelayo ukuba asebenze lapha.
identity.travel_intro_before: Umuntu ohambayo angasebenza nge-server engeyikhaya lakhe, ngoba isimo sakhe somphakathi sihamba njengento esayiniwe, esisha
identity.two_id_body: I-akhawunti yakho yomsebenzi ifakazela ukuthi yiliphi ibhokisi elikhulumayo; ukuqinisekisa komvoti kufakazela ukuthi yini abangayenza. Akukho okungafundwa njengokunye — futhi akukho okuthenga ubungcweti bomthethosisekelo.
identity.wall_body: I-Operator identity ihlukile ngokuphelele ku-citizen identity — i-akhawunti yomsebenzi ayinakuxhumana nanoma yimuphi umvoti.
identity.what_att_body: Isithombe esisha (≤ 24h), esingakhutshelwa emuva, esayiniwe nge-instance sesimo somuntu esitholakele, esibotshelwe ekeyini yedivayisi. Igunya laseKHAYA kuphela eliqinisekisa. Lethwe isimo somphakathi kuphela — hhayi imininingwane, izindawo, noma amaphepha okuvota.
identity.what_att_cite: Igunya lasekhaya kuphela eliqinisekisa · ≤ 24h · singakhutshelwa emuva · esayiniwe nge-instance
identity.your_identity_intro: Ukuthi leli bhokisi lingubani ku-mesh, nokuthi ungubani kuleli bhokisi. Lena yiyi-infrastructure identity — ayiniki ivoti, isihlalo, noma ukuzwa komthethosisekelo.

mesh.about: Ikhonsoli efunda i-mesh njengoba injalo — izihlobo zivela ku-handshake registry, izindlela zethu zokuthutha ezaziwayo, ama-live peerage gates, kanye nezincazelo ezingu-25 zokugcina ze-append-only sync ledger. Yonke ukuhlanganiswa, ukusincwa nokuhamba okuyikhombisa kurekhodiwe yizinsizwa zomfelandawonye; ikhasi alishintshi lutho. Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Cluster kuyisisekelo, hhayi isinqumo somthethosisekelo: akuniki voti, isihlalo, noma igunya phezu kwirekhodi yanoma iyiphi indawo.
mesh.authority_after: node: isenzo siqinisekisiwe — sisawe yithuluzi labo, siphethe ubufakazi obuvela kuserba lasekhaya — futhi sithunyelwe ekhophi yesibuko yendawo.
mesh.authority_before: Kuyo yonke indawo yegunya, irekhodi lebhokisi elilodwa iyona enegunya — iqiniso lokubhalwa kwama-akhawunti ngokuthi ikhophi yesibuko yasekhaya iphi, hhayi isimo senqaba. Umdlali angasebenza ku
mesh.becoming_before: Kukhona indlela eyodwa yokuphakama, futhi yonke imininingwane iyihamba: thola isitifiketi, thatha amaklayenti, futhi uphethe irekhodi lomphakathi yonke. Uma usungene, ibhokisi lakho lingumphakathi ogcwele nolingana — lisebenzela abadlali njengemininingwane eyinye. Ukukhuliswa kwezindima kuyisigaba esihlukile esivikeleke ngokwethenjwa ku
mesh.differ_body: Izinto ezimbili kuphela. Izinsizakalo i-hardware yebhokisi engakwazi ukuzihostha — ibhokisi elincane lingase lishaye izwi noma amaqelo aqondile. Namakhanalu amazalo avikeleke ngokwethenjwa, afika ngaphansi kwezindawo zomphakathi omunye ngakho adinga imvume yabo.
mesh.federation_url: URL yomfelandawonye — indlela abaphakathi abibiza ngayo leli bhokisi:
mesh.ffc_body: Uma abaphakathi bephatha amarekhodi omunye nomunye, i-sync ledger iyisiphiwo. Umugqa ngamunye ukuthumela noma ukudonsa, nomphumela wawo nobubanzi berekhodi obululwe. Umphumela othi “igunya alingiswani → lxazululekile” usho ukuthi ukungaboni ngaso linye kuxazululekile ngokunqoba kwekhophi yesibuko yasekhaya yendawo — irekhodi yomthethosisekelo ayihlukani neze.
mesh.gates_body: Lokhu okusadingeka kuleli bhokisi ngaphambi kokuba (noma ukuze lihlale) kube umphakathi ogcwele — isitifiketi, ubuntu, i-URL efikeleleka. Isango ngasinye sihlolwa ngokuphila; akukho okulapha okuyisimo senqaba, kodwa kulungiselelo kuphela.
mesh.intro: Indlela imininingwane yakho ethola ngayo abaphakathi bayo, iphathe amarekhodi abo, futhi isinde kunetwork ebanga — igama lomfelandawonye umdlalo womvoti ohamba ngalo.
mesh.ledger_lr_after: — njengarekhodi lonke ohlelo lomthethosisekelo, lingafundwa noma ubani futhi alibuyiselwa neze.
mesh.moving_body: Uma ibhokisi lasekhaya liphetha (noma uhulumeni walo ekhetha omunye omhostha), igunya lishintsha ngezinyathelo ezintathu eziqinisekisiwe:
mesh.moving_note: Akukho okulahleka futhi akukho okumisa: ukufunda kuqhubeka yonke indawo, nokubhala okuthunyelwe kubekwa emilandwini kuze kube yilapho kushintshwa.
mesh.moving_title: Ukushintsha ikhophi yesibuko yasekhaya yendawo yegunya
mesh.no_peers_after: . Ukuhlanganyela akukushintshi igunya: ibhokisi eliphethe ikhophi yasekhaya yendawo lihlele lapho belikhona.
mesh.no_peers_before: Ayikho imishini ehambisana nayo okwamanje — leli bhokisi limile lodwa. Ukuhlanganyela iqela kuqala ngesikhiye sokuhlanganyela esenziwe ngumphathi wehost; isiqondiso sokuhlanganyela sikhona
mesh.no_sync: Ayikho imibhalo yokuvumelanisa okwamanje — irekhodi liqala ukubhala ngomzuzu lapho umshini ohambisana nawo uthatha imibhalo uye kuleli bhokisi noma uvela kulo.
mesh.no_transports: Ayikho imithutha ekhangisiwe okwamanje — imishini ehambisana nayo isengafika kuleli bhokisi ku-URL yomfelandawonye engaphansi, kodwa ukubhalisa imithutha kunikeza inkimbinkimbi izindlela zokubuyela emuva lapho leyo URL ihlela.
mesh.peerage_cite: Inqubo eyodwa yokuba ngumshini ohambisana nayo — igunya lihambisana nendawo, hhayi unode
mesh.peers_body: Yonke ibhokisi leli node elibingelelane nalo, nokuthi yiliphi lona elisezingeni lothemba. I-chip yobudlelwano ibhalela ukuthi ume kanjani kunomshini ohambisana nawo — ichaza ukubekwa kwedatha, hhayi isikhundla.
mesh.peers_caption: Imishini ehambisana nayo kanye nomjikelezo wothemba
mesh.plane_off_body: Ukuhlanganyela, ukuvumelanisa nokunika amagama imishini ehambisana nayo kuyizikhả — akuthengi ukuvota, isihlalo, noma ukuba nomuzwa kunoma isiphi isinqumo somthethosisekelo.
mesh.relation_mirror: aliphethe ikhophi yasekhaya yendawo lapha — kusasele ukuba ngumshini ohambisana nayo ogcwele kokufunda nokubhala okuthunyelwe
mesh.relation_sovereign: umshini ohambisana nayo onamakhophi akhe asekhaya — sivumelanisa ngezindlela zombili
mesh.signin_body: Imishini ehambisana nayo, imithutha neirekhodi lokuvumelanisa kuboniswa kuphela kumphathi ongenile waleli bhokisi. Izakhamuzi zidlalela umdlalo; abaphathi bagcina ibhokisi linqunyiwe enkimbinkimbi.

mesh.step_export_body: — ibhokisi elihambayo liqala ukuthutha imibhalo yendawo yegunya esayiniwe.
mesh.step_flip_body: — umshini ohambisana nawo olandelayo uluqinisekisa ngokwakho irekhodi lokucwaninga, kanti inkimbinkimbi ibhala ikhaya elisha.

mesh.trust_lifecycle: Umjikelezo wokwethemba: tholwe · ukubambisana · ukwethemba kwasungulwa · ukuxhumana · isivumelwano somngcele
moderation.about_before: Ukugcina → ukubika → ukususa yililandelelo le-M-5; ukususa akukaze kuthinte i-ACL yeseva yomlingani futhi akukaze kurekhode i-hash. Kubona lokhu ohlangothini lomvoti ku
moderation.above_body: Ubufakazi bobulungiswa obuphilayo, obunokhiye (R-19/R-20) kuphela obususa noma yini. Umsebenzi akasahlonishwa — ngikhowudi, hhayi ngenqubo.
moderation.below_body_before: Umsebenzi angadlulisa ukususa ukuvikelwa kwamalungelo — kurekhodiwe ngokusekelwe ku
moderation.carve_m2_who: Ukudlulisa komsebenzi ngaphansi kokushintsha → ubulungiswa ngaphezulu kwakho
moderation.flip_body: Ukushintsha kwenzeka ngokuzenzela — kusekelwe emaqinisweni, akukho shintsho senza ngesandla. Ngaphansi: ibhodi yomsebenzi idlulisa uvikelelo oluncane. Ngaphezulu: ubufakazi bobulungiswa obuphelayo kuphela obususa noma yini.
moderation.intro: Umsebenzi akanalo igunya lokususa ngenxa yombono — ukuhlinzeka indawo akukuniki amandla okunciphisa. Ngaphansi kokushintsha, umsebenzi angadlulisa kuphela uvikelelo oluncane, konke kubhalwa; ngomzuzu lapho uhulumeni ehlala esihlalweni, igunya lokususa lidlulela emajajini kanti ukudlulisa komsebenzi kuvala ngokuzenzela.
moderation.legal_floor_body: I-akhawunti yomsebenzi ngokuba nekhiyi — hhayi ubufakazi obumile, ngaphandle kwezinga lomthethosisekelo. Uhlu lwezisekelo zomthetho luvaliwe, lukhula kuphela ngokukhishwa kwekhodi; uhlu lwe-SOURCE lubhalwa, hhayi i-hash; irekhodi iyengezwa kuphela.
moderation.legal_floor_cite: Ukuba nekhiyi · uhlu oluvaliwe · irekhodi eqinisiwe eyengezwa kuphela · F-SOC-004
moderation.no_content_control_after: Alikho ukuze linikezwe, lidalulwe, noma lithathwe — ukuvimba komsebenzisi ngamunye kuthinta kuphela isikrini somvimbi futhi akukaze kubhalwe ndawo.
moderation.signin_body: Irekhodi yokulawula eqinisiwe iboniswa kuphela kumsebenzi ongene kule bhokisi.
moderation.trail_empty_after: Akukaze kube nokukhipha okusetshenzisiwe futhi akukaze kube nokususa kwezinga lomthetho okufayilwe kule bhokisi.

roles.approval_cite: Ukuvuma kukhipha imvume eqinisekisiwe — ukuvuma okukabili (Art. VII ukwamukeleka; ukuthatha indawo kukahulumeni ohleliwe), hhayi ukuzikhiphela imvume. Ukususa eyodwa yezinhlabathi zakho kuhleleka ngohlangothi olulodwa.
roles.channels_caption: Izindlela eziyisishiyagalolunye zekhono, uhlobo lokuvuma kwazo, isimo esiphilayo kule nodi, nezenzo
roles.field_scope_hint: Shiya isikhala indawo yegunya eyisisekelo. Ukunikeza amandla kusebenza endaweni — hhayi kumeshi njengezikhundla.
roles.founding_body: Alikho imesh okumele iphendule futhi akukho hulumende ohleliwe, ngakho yonke indima ingeyakho ukuyivula ngqo — kuhlanganise nezindlela ezilawulwayo. Uma umhlaba wakho usungumsizi futhi uhulumende uhleliwe, izindlela ezilawulwayo zibuyela endleleni yokuvuma yemitha emibili kunoma yikuphi ukushintsha okuzayo.
roles.four_roles_intro: Amagama amane ajwayelekile aqoqa izindlela eziyisishiyagalolunye — akukho amandla amasha, kuwukugeqa nje. Ikhadi ngalinye likhombisa isethi yendlela yalo, umsebenzi owuthathayo, nokuthi lizivula ngokwalalo noma lidinga isinqumo sikahulumende.
roles.governed_gloss: Okulawulwayo — kucelwe, bese kulandela ukuvuma kwemitha emibili (ibhodi yabasebenzi, noma uhulumende ohleliwe).
roles.intro: I“ndima” yebhokisi ayikho lutho ngaphandle kwesethi yezindlela zekhono eziluhlelayo. Ithemba lapha lihlangene — wengeza izindlela ongazisebenzisa, ngelinye ngelinye. Azikho izinga okukhuphukela kulo futhi akukho isikhundla okufanele usithole.

roles.mesh_channel.mirror.what: Yenza ikhophi yesibuko ye-cluster efundeka kuphela (ayinakugunya lutho) — i-standby ebandayo.
roles.mesh_channel.voice.sfu.what: Hosta i-LiveKit selective-forwarding unit yezwi + yevidiyo.
roles.mesh_role.archivist.duty: Amukela futhi uqophe ngokwethembeka ukubhala kwezindawo zegunya onazo igunya.
roles.mesh_role.archivist.label: Umlondolo wezincwadi
roles.mesh_role.archivist.what: Hambisa iklayenti futhi ubambe igunya lokufunda nokubhala lendawo yegunya.
roles.mesh_role.identity_broker.duty: Nikela amagama + izitifiketi ngokwethembeka ngaphansi kwezingcambu zamagama onikezwe zona.
roles.mesh_role.identity_broker.label: I-Broker ye-Identity
roles.mesh_role.identity_broker.what: Dala ama-subdomain, nikela izitifiketi ze-TLS, futhi ukhishe izimvume ze-capability ze-mesh.
roles.mesh_role.record_keeper.duty: Gcina ikhophi efundeka kuphela ethembekile ye-mesh futhi uhambise idatha yayo esindayo emabhazini.
roles.mesh_role.record_keeper.label: Ugcinisizincwadi
roles.mesh_role.record_keeper.what: Bamba uhlanga lwedatha — yenza ikhophi yesibuko yirekhodi efundeka kuphela futhi uhosta i-geodata.
roles.mesh_role.social_moderator.duty: Gcina i-commons esebenzayo itholakala; ukulawula kuqhubeka kungakhethi okuqukethwe futhi kungekho okungavimbeka ngokukhipha.
roles.mesh_role.social_moderator.label: Ulawuli Soccer
roles.mesh_role.social_moderator.what: Hosta isikwele somphakathi + amaholo (Matrix) nezwi/evidiyo lendawo yegunya.
roles.meter_a_applies: indlela yokuqala, ngaphambi kokuba uhulumeni uhlale esihlalweni
roles.meter_a_threshold: umsebenzisi 1 → wena kuphela · 2 → ukuvumelana ngokuphelele · 3+ → izithathu ezimbili
roles.meter_b_applies: isikhathi lapho isishayamthetho sihlala esihlalweni — lokhu KUTHATHA INDAWO ye-Meter A
roles.meter_b_who: izishayamthetho ezilungele, ngeningi elikhethekile (ukuvota kwezindawo zegunya eziningi)
roles.meter_c_applies: izinhamba kuphela ezisebenza ngaphansi kwe-zone yebhazi — broker.dns, authority.grant
roles.meter_c_threshold: uvumelwano oluphelele (noma yimuphi omunye ongalingana angala)
roles.meter_c_title: izinqumo ngaphansi kwendawo yongalingana — ongalingana abathintekayo kumele bavume
roles.meter_c_who: wonke ongalingana lapho isigaba sakhe sithintwa khona
roles.nine_intro_1: Isilulumagama sonke esivaliwe. Izigaba ezintathu zi-
roles.nine_intro_2: — futhi azidingi isivusa-muso: zichaza kuphela lokho ibhokisi lakho elikwenzayo. Ezinye ezisithupha zi-
roles.nine_intro_3: , ngoba ngasinye sinikeza umsebenzi phezu kwezinye, noma sibeka igama ngaphansi kwendawo yongalingana.
roles.no_pending: Azikho izicelo zokunikeza izindima ezivulekile. Isicelo esibusekayo esivulwe nguwe noma ongalingana sizovela lapha nesimo somlingisi waso.
roles.pending_caption: Izicelo zokunikeza izindima ezivulekile nezifunda zomlingisi wokuvuma
roles.petition_gloss: Igunya lokufunda nokubhala liqiniso mayelana nendawo — lapho ikhophi yakhona ehlala khona. Lishintsha phakathi kwamanodi avumileyo ngokwe-indawo yegunya; akusona isikhundla leli bhokisi elifuna ngesicelo.
roles.plane_off_body: Ukuqhuba inodi kuyisisekelo, akusona isilungelelo somuzi — akukuniki ukuvota okwengeziwe, isihlalo, noma ukuzwa kunoma isiphi isinqumo somthethosisekelo. Ama-akhawunti abaqhuba angenalo uxhumano nabasebenzisi abazingizane.
roles.probe_meter_c: Lesi sigaba sisebenza ngaphansi kwendawo yongalingana — ongalingana abathintekayo kumele bavume futhi (Umlingisi C).
roles.run_step_body: Uku-fanekisa kuhlolwa ukuthi leli bhokisi lingabamba isigaba yini — akushintshi lutho. Isicelo sivula isigaba esizigqajisile, noma sivula isicelo esibusekayo ukuze umlingisi omabili ancide.
roles.seated_gloss: Uhulumeni ohleli esihlalweni uvuma ngokuvota kwalo — leli bhakithi lingaqinisekisa kuphela Umlingisi A, futhi ukunikezwa kuzovala ngokucashunwa kwalo kuze kube yilapho lokhu kuvota kuvunyelwe.
roles.self_gloss: Okuzigqajisile — zonke izigaba ziyaqala ngokuchofoza kanye; akukho sivusa-musno.
roles.self_vs_gov_body: Isigaba ozizibekele sona athinta wena wedwa, ngakho singesakho ukusivula. Isigaba esilawulwayo sinika umsebenzi phezu kwabanye abantu noma sibhala igama ngaphansi kwendawo yomakhelwane — ngakho sicelwa, asizithathwa, futhi sivunywa yikhomiti eyizibili ngezansi.
roles.signed_in_grant: Ungene njenge {name} · isipho sihlale sihambisana nendawo
roles.signin_body: Ibhodi yamaqhaza ibonakala kuphela kumsebenzi ongene. Ama-akhawunti asebenzi asebenza ezingeni lomsebenzi — awunalo utingidwe nabazise citizen futhi awunamandla ezisebenzi.
roles.waiting_dual_meter: Kulindwe ikhomiti eyizibili — bheka uhlu olulindile ngezansi.
roles.waiting_intro: Isigaba esilawulwayo sivunywa yikhomiti eyizibili — abasebenzi ngenkathi kungekho hulumende ohleliwe, hulumende ohleliwe ngesikhathi ekhona — kanye nekhomiti yesithathu zezigaba ezimbalwa ezingena ngaphansi kwendawo yomakhelwane. Amamitha ngezansi ayizifundo eziphilayo; akukho lapha okubala kabusha ivoti.
sim_console.chamber_note: Igumbi liba khona masinyane lapho indawo isebenziswa, kodwa ukhetho kuphela olufaka abantu kulo — ukuhlisa noma ubani ngaphandle kwalokho kungakhipha amalungu anguvotiwe. Igumbi elingenamuntu yisimo esifanele, hhayi ukuhluleka.
sim_console.draft_after: kuze kube yilapho kuvunywa, futhi igumbi elingaphezu kwezihlalo eziyisishiyagalolunye alikwazi ukukhetha ngaphandle kokuba kunomuhlelo ovunyelwe.
sim_console.halt_requested: Kucelwe ukuma — abasebenzi bayama emngceleni wabo olandelayo, hhayi phakathi kwento. Ukususa isifanekiso kuqhubeka khona lapho kwimele.
sim_console.no_run_after: — le khasi liyavuka phakathi nomzuzu, lapho ipompi ihlanyela abasebenzi bayo bokuqala.
sim_console.no_run_before: Ayikho ukuhamba kokugcwalisa okusekhona. Qala ngoku
sim_console.over_bound_body_after: sevele sabuyisa amalungu ngaphansi kwenani lezihlalo elingenalo umthetho ovumelelekile.
sim_console.over_bound_body_before: Art. V §3 kubopha ikhamari loHlobo B nenani loHlobo A. Lokhu kudlula lokho: isigaba sezihlalo siqala ezihlalweni ezimbili ngumvoti futhi angeke siye phansi, kanti isinyathelo esilandelayo — ukuqoqa izindawo zegunya zabavoti eziphathwa ngokuhlanganyela — asikakhaliwe. Ikhamari emakisiwe
sim_console.paused: Kumiwe ngumbulali wedatha kuze kube {until} — kubonakale ukuqala kabusha kwe-Postgres. Lokhu kumisa izicelo; akukaze kulahleke umsebenzi.
sim_console.people_minted_note: Abantu abadalwe bahlelele ukuba baphansi kakhulu kwabantu abaklanyelwe: ubuntu buyadalwa kuphela lapho umthethosisekelo ukudinga — umkhethwa, ilungu — kanti bonke abanye babalwa njengequlu kunokuba bagcinwe njengomugqa.
sim_console.prod_warn_mid: , ngakho alinawo adata ashintshiwe futhi injini yokugcwalisa izenqaba ukusebenza lapha. Injini isebenza kuphela enanini elikilaswe
sim_console.seat_gap_body: Umthetho we-cube-root unquma ukuthi ikhamari inezihlalo ezingaki; izifunda zayo kumele zihlangane ngqo kulokho. Lapho zingakwenzi, umehluko uyizihlalo umthethosisekelo ozishumayela kodwa ukhetho lungakwazi ukuzigcwalisa — ukubala konke kusala kuncane, phakade. Lokhu kuyiphutha ohlelweni lwesifunda, futhi ukudweba kabusha kuphela okungakulungisa.
sim_console.smoke_hint: Umunyuzelo we-smoke ubala kuphela izindawo zegunya ezi-N ezinkulu — shiya isikhala ukuze ugcwalise wonke isethi. Ukubala kuhamba emugqeni; imigqa iyavuka phakathi nomzuzu.
sim_console.subtitle: Eqinisweni. Ivuselelwa njalo ngemizuzwana eyi-2 kusuka ohlelweni lomsebenzi — azikho izibalo ezogcinwe.
versioning.about: Leli khonsoli likhombisa iqiniso lezinguqulo eligcinwe isevisi yesivumelwano sokuthuthukisa — aliphindi lwakhe isilinganiso noma lishintshe inguqulo. Iziphakamiso zihambiswa ngezisevisi ze-mesh; ukubuyela emuva komthethosisekelo akukwazi ukudlula efilitreni eqinile, noma ngubani ovumile.
versioning.answerable_body: Abasebenzi baqala ukuthuthukisa; abalobi bomthetho. Ifilitha liqinile, ukuqibilika kuyizimishini, kanti uhulumeni ohleliwe unegama lokugcina.
versioning.const_version_cite: inguqulo yomthethosisekelo — isikhiya semithetho eqinile esebenza
versioning.failclosed_body: Inguqulo ehlukile imisa ukuhlanganisa kunokuhlanganisa imithetho engafani ngasese. Uhlangothi olunye luvuma ukuthuthukiswa — ngalezi zilinganiso ezingezansi — ngaphambi kokuba kuqhubeke.
versioning.failclosed_title: Ivaleka lapho kuhluleka, hhayi ngokuzama okungcono kakhulu.
versioning.freeze_body: Lapho umdlalo uqala, ukuncintisana kubamba inguqulo yomthethosisekelo esebenza ngaleso sikhathi. Noma yikuphi ukuthuthukiswa okuvunyelwe kufika ekuncintisaneni okulandelayo — hhayi kuleyo esemdlalweni — ukuze kube kungekho muntu ongashintsha imithetho emaphepheni lokuvota asevele wavotwa.
versioning.freeze_note: Ukugcina ngu-function ecwebile yerekhodi lokuncintisana; akukho ukuchitha ukuvimba okwenziwa ngesandla ukuze kuvulwe umdlalo osebenza.
versioning.freeze_strong: Ukhetho noma iseshini esisebenza sigcina inguqulo yaso.
versioning.intro: Indlela inguqulo ehambisana ngayo ku-mesh — lokhu okuvulwa yilokhu node, lokhu okukhangiswa yiqabane lonke, neziphakamiso ezivulekile ezilindele ukuvuma. Konke ukushintsha komthethosisekelo kuhlolwa yifilitha eqinile kuqala, bese kuvunyelwa ngabantu abaphethe amandla ngempela.
versioning.meters_cite: U-A no-B yizinyawo ezimbili zesihlalo esisodwa — ibhodi yophathi iqinisekisa kuphela lapho kungekho hulumeni ohlezi; ngomzuzu lapho kuhlala khona omunye, iningi lakhe elikhethekile lithatha indawo yebhodi. U-C ngumlingani wonke osungulwe ngokwethenjwa obamba ikhophi yasekhaya yendawo ethinteke ngokufana (ngokuvumelana; idlula ngokwayo lapho kungekho umlingani onjalo).
versioning.no_meters: akukho amamitha — lolu hlobo luhamba ngokuzenzakalela
versioning.no_peers: Akukho mulingani okwamanje — le bhokisi limile lodwa. Izinguqulo ziqala ukubaluleka ngomzuzu lapho ibhokisi lesibili lihlangana ne-mesh.
versioning.no_proposals: Akukho ziphakamiso ezivulekile — i-mesh iyavumelana ngenguqulo esebenzayo.
versioning.peer_versions_body: Umlingani wonke omenyezela inguqulo yakhe yomthethosisekelo. Umlingani oseguqulweni eluhlukile angeke akwazi ukuxhumana — i-mesh inqaba kuze kube yilapho omabili ohlangothi evumelane nokuthuthukiswa.
versioning.plane_off_body: Ukuthuthukisa isoftware kuyikhono lebhodi yophathi, hhayi ilungelo lomuzi. Imithetho yomthethosisekelo uqobo ayishintshwa lapha — ushintsho lweguqulo luphakamiswa, luhlolwe, bese kuphela lapho kuvumelwa ngabantu abaphethe amandla ngempela.
versioning.proposals_body: Isiphakamiso sihlolwa kuqala, sivunyelwe okwesibili. Imitha yonke esebenzayo kumele idlule; imitha engasebenzi ohlobo lwesiphakamiso noma ubude bayo ayidingeki.
versioning.screened_body: Isiphakamiso ngasinye sidlula uhlungiselele oluqinile lokwamukeleka ngaphambi kokuba kuvotwe. Leso okungaba ukwehlisa ukulingana, noma ukwehlisa iningi elikhethekile kube ngaphansi kweningi-plus-one, liyanقwa ngqo — akukho mitha, akukho phathi, futhi akukho amandla angalidlulisa.
versioning.signin_body: Izinguqulo neziphakamiso zokuthuthukisa ziboniswa kuphela kuphathi osayine-in. Akukho okunqunywa lapha ngaphandle kwemvume — ushintsho lweguqulo lususa amamitha, hhayi ikonsoli.
versioning.three_kinds: Izinhlobo ezintathu zenguqulo zihamba ngokuzimela. Inguqulo yomthethosisekelo kuphela ethinta ubuso obuqinile — yona yedwa edlula uhlungiselele namamitha angezansi; ukukhishwa kwe-app nokunyusa kweskema kuhamba ngokuzenzakalela.
